zh.summary: Windows 工作区选择现在属于 DeepSeek Harness 桌面窗口，不再显示 Node 图标或只在任务栏闪烁。
highlights: 选择工作区时使用由主窗口持有的原生文件夹对话框，会直接显示在 DeepSeek Harness 前方。
对话框跟随桌面程序的任务栏身份和窗口生命周期，不再产生 Node 子进程窗口。
该桌面壳修复需要一次完整包升级；会话、设置、插件和工作区数据保持不变。

en.summary: Workspace selection on Windows now belongs to the DeepSeek Harness desktop window instead of flashing as a Node window.
highlights: The workspace picker is now a native folder dialog owned by the main DeepSeek Harness window and opens in front of it.
The dialog shares the desktop app's taskbar identity and lifetime instead of creating a Node child-process window.
This desktop-shell fix requires one full-package update; sessions, settings, plugins, and workspace data are preserved.
